Raydar is recruiting for a role on behalf of a fast-growing software company. The Product Software Engineer will own product engineering work across front-end development and AI-driven product features, connecting language models to user-facing workflows and shipping reliable solutions quickly. The role involves close collaboration with design and engineering leadership in an on-site startup environment.
Management Consulting
Responsibilities
Take on product engineering problems that demand accuracy and a fast pace, and see them through to a polished finish
Finish and harden front-end work that begins as AI-assisted drafts
Build new AI-driven behaviors and widen the set of tools that an automated assistant feature can use
Connect language models to user-facing product workflows
Ship reliably and quickly with a high degree of ownership
Work closely with design, front-end and engineering leadership colleagues
Qualification
Front-End Development
Product Engineering
AI Coding Tools
Agent-Style Systems
Language Models
Required
1 to 4 years of experience shipping product engineering work, ideally at a startup
Strong front-end skills with real product engineering depth
Fluency with AI coding tools as a way to work faster, combined with careful review of every line of code
Comfort building with agent-style systems that rely on language models
Proven pace and high agency, with a track record of moving through hard problems without long lead times
Clear, genuine preference for startup work over large-company environments
Evidence of self-started projects such as side businesses, personal apps or hackathon builds
Low ego, collaborative working style and a sense of ownership when discussing past achievements
Preferred
Prior delivery of features powered by language models, from design through release
A front-end background paired with strong product instincts, noticing when the user experience is off rather than building strictly to spec
Experience at a high-growth startup through a rapid scaling phase
Public side projects or a visible GitHub footprint
Exposure to the travel industry

Equity
Health insurance
